//: Source of the shared row classes of ontola/atomic-plugins#177 (option 4). `node ontology-kit/ontology.mjs build` turns this plus base.json into the published term files under ontology/ and the subject constants in terms.mjs. A reference in requires, recommends or classtype is either a term defined here (a property shortname, or a class name) or an absolute URL of an existing term that is reused, never copied. Published terms never change: a change of meaning gets a new shortname or class version (see ontology-kit/README.md). Every term is declared, not verified.

v1.name: Shared row classes v1
v1.description: Row classes that several atomic-plugins drive apps sync into, so a plugin's view works on any table of that class (ontola/atomic-plugins#177). Declared, not verified: no plugin writes these classes yet.

event-v1.name: Event
event-v1.description: A calendar event. Placed by its first civil day and, for multi-day or all-day events, its exclusive end day; timed events also carry their exact start and end instants as RFC 3339 strings with offset. Provider data (ids, ETags, links, sync baselines) is not part of this class.

issue-v1.name: Issue
issue-v1.description: An issue or task, using the task/v1 vocabulary every AtomicServer embeds: status (todo, doing, blocked, done; done is closed), body, assignee and due date. Provider data (issue numbers, labels, comments, sync state) is not part of this class.

time-entry-v1.name: Time entry
time-entry-v1.description: One interval of work: a start instant, an end instant (absent while a timer runs), and optionally a project, a person and a billable flag. Provider data (source ids, observation logs) is not part of this class.

work-project-v1.name: Project
work-project-v1.description: A named body of work that time entries belong to.

work-person-v1.name: Person
work-person-v1.description: A person who performed work, by name. Not an Atomic authentication agent.

bank-transaction-v1.name: Bank transaction
bank-transaction-v1.description: A booked bank transaction: account, currency, an exact signed decimal amount and a value date, plus the bank's own narrative and reference and the person's own category and note. Import bookkeeping (source ids, fingerprints, statement numbers) is not part of this class.

atomic-calendar-day.name: Day
atomic-calendar-day.description: First civil day of the event (YYYY-MM-DD), in the event's own time zone as the provider gives it. The shortname is the one AtomicServer's built-in Calendar view matches (calendarFields).

atomic-calendar-end-day.name: End day
atomic-calendar-end-day.description: Exclusive end day (YYYY-MM-DD) of a multi-day or all-day event: the first day it no longer covers. Absent means a single day.

atomic-calendar-all-day.name: All day
atomic-calendar-all-day.description: Whether the event lasts whole days. Absent means false.

atomic-calendar-start.name: Start
atomic-calendar-start.description: Exact start instant of a timed event, as an RFC 3339 date-time string with its UTC offset, exactly as the provider gave it. A string rather than a timestamp, so the offset is kept.

atomic-calendar-end.name: End
atomic-calendar-end.description: Exact exclusive end instant of a timed event, as an RFC 3339 date-time string with its UTC offset.

atomic-calendar-location.name: Location
atomic-calendar-location.description: Where the event takes place, as free text.

atomic-calendar-notes.name: Notes
atomic-calendar-notes.description: The event's description, as plain text.

atomic-calendar-recurrence.name: Recurrence
atomic-calendar-recurrence.description: Recurrence rule, in the JSON payload AtomicServer's calendar-recurrence reads (browser/lib/src/calendar-recurrence.ts).

work-start.name: Start
work-start.description: Start instant of a work interval, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

work-end.name: End
work-end.description: End instant of a completed work interval, milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Absent while a timer is running.

work-project.name: Project
work-project.description: Project this work interval belongs to.

work-billable.name: Billable
work-billable.description: Whether this work interval is marked billable. Does not imply invoicing or payment.

bank-account.name: Account
bank-account.description: Account identifier: an IBAN when the bank gives one, otherwise the bank's own account id.

bank-currency.name: Currency
bank-currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the amount.

bank-amount.name: Amount
bank-amount.description: Exact signed decimal string in the account currency, at most 5 fraction digits. Negative is money out; positive is money in.

bank-value-date.name: Value date
bank-value-date.description: Bank value date (YYYY-MM-DD), without an inferred time zone.

bank-description.name: Description
bank-description.description: The bank's original narrative for the transaction, verbatim.

bank-reference.name: Reference
bank-reference.description: Bank reference, or customer reference if the bank gives none.

money-category.name: Category
money-category.description: The person's own category for this transaction, as free text. Never written by an importer.

money-note.name: Note
money-note.description: The person's own note on this transaction. Never written by an importer.
